title: AtlasEvaluationResult
description: One Atlas-normalized benchmark evaluation for an exact model/revision identity. Raw source score is always preserved; base-model scores never stand in for quantized variants; different benchmark versions are never merged. Specification version 0.6.0 (pre-1.0).

model_id.description: Canonical Atlas model_id this evaluation is attached to.

model_revision.description: Exact evaluated revision when the source states it; null means unresolved.

artifact_id.description: Exact artifact variant evaluated, when the evaluation names one.

quantization.description: Exact quant label tested; a base-model score never stands in for a quantized variant.

benchmark_id.description: Stable benchmark identity slug (name + version family, not the raw score).

benchmark_version.description: Benchmark/harness version; null means unstated. Different versions are never compared as equals.

suite_version.description: Evaluation suite version (e.g. Intelligence Index v4.3.2) when applicable.

metric_direction.description: Direction is explicit; never assume higher is better.

score_unit.description: Unit is part of the result; unitless cross-benchmark comparison is forbidden.

reasoning_mode.description: e.g. thinking / non-thinking / max-reasoning; never compared across modes without disclosure.

evaluation_origin.description: Publisher results are never relabeled independent; two republishers are not two evaluations.

evaluation_date.description: Source evaluation date; null means unstated (unknown, never invented).

match_status.description: Ambiguous or conflicting identities are excluded from strict ranking.
